get.description: Look up bundle setup by key, or a route-scoped result by its key and canonical operationPath. The service rechecks current action authority before returning a result.

post.description: Existing commit wins; otherwise fence the matching global or route-scoped identity. Repeatable; late marked and unmarked writes cannot pass the fence.

get.description: Current browser administrator only; not a global directory or machine-token grant.
Current browser administrator only. Null role means verified identity with no membership in this workspace.
Newest 200 machine tokens. Secrets are never returned. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

post.description: Issue an expiring machine token. The secret is returned once and stored only as a SHA-256 digest. Its principal is `machine:{name}`. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

Issue a successor with the same principal and rights. With `overlapSeconds` 0 the old token is revoked; otherwise its expiry is shortened to the overlap. Only an active token can be rotated (`machine_token_inactive`). Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.
Revoke a token. Idempotent; the first reason is retained. Applies to the token's next request. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

get.description: Newest 200 entries of the append-only token audit trail. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.
